title: More useful no-results message
body:
In the [instant-search-demo built using the algoliasearch-helper](https://demo.algolia.com/examples/instant-search/jquery/), there is a neat "no-results" UI that contains the currently active filters.
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/2853038/17312198/e12766dc-5805-11e6-9a95-0d6c9da2680c.png)

Unless I missed something, recreating this with instantsearch.js requires a custom widget (the widget `currentrefinedvalues` can't be easily integrated into the no-results message).

Would it be possible to have this feature handled natively by the library?

comments.body:
> Have you tried the currentRefinedValues widget?

Yes, but @kokliKo mentions it's complex to use "inside" the no-results page.

My bad :/ As of now the widgets are not composable and thus you can't mix them together. What about an option for the `hits` widget? I know we want to limit the number of options for the widgets, but if this case make sense we could internally reuse the widget.

Not sure about what's the best solution, maybe an option for the `hits` widget would be good like you mentioned.

Having a way to remove refined facets when having no-results is - I think - a best practice in terms of UX, so I would advocate for having it in the default widgets one way or another.

> Having a way to remove refined facets when having no-results is - I think - a best practice in terms of UX, so I would advocate for having it in the default widgets one way or another.

Are you considering having an option in each widget?
Hmmmm didn't think about that. I don't think it's necessary though. Having it in the `hits` should be enough.
We should try to see how to do that by making a prototype and depending on the difficulty, let's see if we do a guide or a super widget. CC @mthuret
There is now a guide for customizing the no results page: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/no-result.html
